title: Deterministic stage cost
statement: Let the output dimension be a positive integer $n$, let the requested bias be a positive rational number at most $1/2$, and let the integral Fourier $1$-norm bound be an integer at least $1$. For an integer $k<n$ and a finite family of subsets of the $n$ coordinates, define the stage cost as the restricted-weight query-batch cost plus a cost with zero random examples and zero membership queries that charges the stage’s local computation in work.
hypotheses_covered: Positive rational bias encoded by a positive numerator and denominator
Encoded bias at most one half
caveat: The referenced restricted-weight query cost and stage local-work quantity are not defined in the supplied statement, so their precise meanings cannot be rendered.
